summary: Treasure's isometric Genesis action-adventure, later preserved through Virtual Console, Sega Classics, mini-console, and Nintendo Classics releases.

entries.title: Light Crusader

emulation.emulator: Nintendo Switch Online Genesis app or Genesis Plus GX
emulation.notes: Use Switch Online for a legal current path; Genesis Plus GX is suitable for an owned-dump archival setup.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Genesis/Mega Drive presentation with emulator save-state and rewind conveniences.

primary.why: The Switch Online Genesis release is the current official access path with save-state and rewind convenience, while the original Genesis cart and older digital/mini-console routes do not add exclusive game content.
primary.how_to_play: Use the SEGA Genesis app through Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack. For owned PC capture, a retained Sega Classics copy remains a fallback after Sega's delisting notice.

all_releases.reason: skip: historically original, but no exclusive content over the current emulated routes.

all_releases.fidelity: Official Wii Virtual Console Genesis release.
all_releases.reason: skip: older storefront path with no unique content over current Nintendo Classics access.

all_releases.platform: Sega Genesis Classics / Sega Mega Drive Classics
all_releases.fidelity: Official Sega emulation collection path across Steam and later home-platform collections.
all_releases.reason: skip: useful only if already owned; Sega's delisting notice makes it a less reliable recommendation than Switch Online.

all_releases.platform: Sega Genesis Mini / Mega Drive Mini
all_releases.reason: skip: official hardware preservation route, but less flexible than current Switch Online play.

all_releases.fidelity: SEGA Genesis - Nintendo Switch Online release with modern emulator conveniences and Switch 2 compatibility marked supported on Nintendo's store page.
all_releases.reason: primary: current official route with convenient save/rewind features and no missing exclusive content.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced exclusive content difference between the known Genesis emulation routes; pick the current official route.

entries.remaster_caveats: All modern paths are emulated Genesis releases rather than remasters.
